entries.positive_observation: Swept dark-brown hair with a high hairline, distinct dark eyebrows, smooth face, sober single mouth, slight viewer-left orientation, brown leather flight jacket, broad shearling collar, gray-green ribbed neck layer and small tan chest layer are visibly retained. The rounded chin meets a short broad fitted neckline without a long stalk, pinching, floating collar, clipping or cream bib. The source pose, crop and warm directional light remain recognizable. Full white/cyan views show solid clothing and no interior holes; the matte outside the bust is only the declared opaque working background.
entries.visible_limitations: The exact tiny shapes of the gray and tan center-chest layers cannot be identified further at 42x46; their visible color groups and positions are retained without claiming additional accessory details.
